1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; __radially reinforcing the device against the tissue to maintain the working channel__; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat brain tissue__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening, __wherein the device is inserted between tissue layers within the brain__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __withdrawing the medical element from the working channel and__ radially contracting and removing the device from the brain.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; __withdrawing any medical element from the device__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __applied to tissue within the working channel to achieve a therapeutic effect__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising __withdrawing the medical element and__ radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue.

11. (Original) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to radially contracting the device__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; __withdrawing any initial medical element from the channel__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the stent channel to treat tissue__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __to minimize disruption of surrounding tissue__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to radially contracting the second expandable body__.
